changes.title: Keep damaged-history counts honest
changes.text: Mark counts reconstructed from truncated, corrupt or seal-mismatched logs as lower bounds while preserving exact clean and validly sealed histories.

changes.title: Retain damaged-history provenance cases
changes.text: Cover clean open history, three damaged statuses, valid sealed history with trailing bytes, and disposable cache-version invalidation.

changes.title: Record exact acceptance boundaries
changes.text: Preserve the TEST208 checkpoint, owner-delivered TEST206 status, pending artifact review, and the next complete gate without claiming results in advance.

commentary: Damaged histories now keep their surviving statistics without presenting lower bounds as exact totals. Clean open and validly sealed logs keep their prior behavior, and raw records are untouched.
